blocks.markdown:
This guidance explains how to plan, carry out and record a field visit. It is
invented for tests.
lines: This guidance explains how to plan, carry out and record a field visit. It is invented for tests.

blocks.markdown:
Read [preparing evidence](#11-preparing-evidence) and the
[payment windows](#a1-payment-windows) before you book a visit. The booking
service is at [the visits portal](HTTPS://Visits.Example.COM:443/book?type=field#start).
lines: Read preparing evidence and the payment windows before you book a visit. The booking service is at the visits portal.

blocks.markdown: Gather the following before you travel:
lines: Gather the following before you travel:

blocks.markdown:
- the holding map, printed at a readable scale
- the previous visit log, if there is one
- a note of any [open query]{.red} or [agreed change]{.blue}
  on the case
lines: the holding map, printed at a readable scale
the previous visit log, if there is one
a note of any open query or agreed change on the case

blocks.markdown:
1. Check the weather.
2. Tell the claimant when you will arrive.
lines: Check the weather.
Tell the claimant when you will arrive.

blocks.markdown:
| Item | Needed for | Notes | | ----------------- | ----------------- | ------------------------------ | | Holding map | Every visit | Print it
and bring a spare | | Measuring wheel | Boundary checks | Wheel \| tape both fine | | Camera | Evidence | Date & time stamp on |
lines: Item | Needed for | Notes
Holding map | Every visit | Print it and bring a spare

blocks.markdown:
Photographs must show the date. Write <u>never</u> crop a photograph, and
label each one with the field reference<sup>1</sup> and the grid square<sub>2</sub>.
lines: Photographs must show the date. Write never crop a photograph, and label each one with the field reference1 and the grid square2.

blocks.markdown: Visit 1: the officer should inspect the orchard on the holding and note its condition in the visit log. Where the orchard has changed since the last visit, compare it with the previous record and explain the difference in plain words. Keep notes short, factual and dated, and attach any supporting evidence to the case before closing the visit.
